name: Athens School of Fine Arts
summary: Athens fine-arts school with two departments, Visual Arts and Art Theory and History; teaching is in Greek and there is no English-taught bachelor's.

handoff.label: ASFA: admission to the Department of Visual Arts

ib.text: Visual Arts: pass ASFA's own five-day practical admission exam; Art Theory and History: the Ministry's foreign-school graduates category (one parent not Greek, no exam). Greek B2 is needed to enrol.

notes: Visual Arts places are won in the school's own practical admission examination (five days in September), not in the Panhellenic exams; ask the Secretariat how a foreign-school applicant sits it.
Its factsheet gives the language of instruction as Greek, with arrangements in English only for Erasmus exchange students.
